DEBUG_BREAK
void DEBUG_BREAK()
View source

Force a break point.

Notes

  • [Emulicious] You need the "Break on ld b, b instruction" exception to be activated.

  • [openMSX] You need the "tools/script/openMSX/debugger_pvm.tcl" script to be loaded to use this function.
